u&yesterday.uk.title: The Buildings That Fought Hitler
u&yesterday.uk.description: We Shall Fight Them In The Streets: The physical defence of London was crucial. A ring of steel and concrete was thrown up around the capital as well as utilising natural defences. S1 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Rise of the Nazis
u&yesterday.uk.description: Stalingrad: The Nazis have lost in Moscow and Hitler and Stalin now take charge of their armies - with no-one to hold them back, Hitler has met his match in a fight to the death. S2 Ep2

u&yesterday.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
u&yesterday.uk.description: Ightham Mote 2: Fiona Bruce presents a second show from Ightham Mote near Sevenoaks, where finds include a collection of postcards that show how a British PoW sent messages to his family. S39 Ep22

u&yesterday.uk.title: Cornwall with Simon Reeve
u&yesterday.uk.description: Simon Reeve investigates the environmental challenges facing Cornwall and the rest of the country and also encounters some of the county's iconic wildlife. S1 Ep2

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: F1 Singapore GP Sprint Race...
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: ...and Qualifying Highlights: The drivers take on Marina Bay's tight, twisting corners in the suffocating humidity for the adrenaline-fuelled Sprint, followed by Qualis under the lights.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: A Few Good Men
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: (1992) High-stakes courtroom drama with more than a few good actors, including Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore and Tom Cruise. Can a lackadaisical naval lawyer crack a battle-hardened colonel?

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Poor Things
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: (2023) Oscar-winning Emma Stone stars in Yorgos Lanthimos's surreal, dark comedy as a suicide brought back to life using the brain of her unborn child. Adapted from Alasdair Gray's novel.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: The Monticello Hotel: Gordon visits the struggling Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington. Can he keep the doors to this 90-year-old establishment open and save 50 jobs?

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Three Women
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Two Women: The drama continues. In Indiana, Gia and Lina's bond is threatened by the sudden arrival of Jack and the revelation of a long-held truth. (Ep7/10)

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Bart's Not Dead: Bart takes a dare that lands him in a coma. To get out of trouble, he says he went to heaven and saw Jesus.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: I Want You (She's So Heavy): Homer's romantic impulses give him a hernia, which comes to life as a man named Wallace thanks to Homer's medication's hallucinatory side effects.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Krusty the Clown: Homer becomes a TV critic. Krusty joins the circus.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Woo-Hoo Dunnit?: There's no shortage of suspects when Lisa's college fund is stolen from under the kitchen sink...

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Mother Simpson: Homer's long-lost mother (guest star Glenn Close) turns up on the run from the police.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Home Sweet Home-Dum-Diddly Doodily: Homer and Marge are sent to Bad Parent School when Bart catches head lice and Lisa loses her shoes.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Sunday Brunch
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Some extra brunch as Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Kirstie's House of Craft
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Kirstie Allsopp puts celebs to the test in head-to-head crafting challenges. Anneka Rice and Cheryl Baker create leather earrings. Jo Wood and Natasha Kaplinsky have a pyrography craft-off.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: In Nottinghamshire, there's romantic crooning and post-meal planking, as Nena and Vish, Syreeta and Romaine, and Paul and Vicki put their hosting skills to the test.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Cheers
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: From Beer to Eternity: Sam challenges rival bar Gary's Tavern to a bowling match, only to find the Cheers regulars are hopelessly bad at the sport. Can Woody step in to help?

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Cheers
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: The Barstoolie: Cliff's thrilled when his long-lost dad visits the bar. Sam suspects that Diane intentionally sabotaged his latest date.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Cheers
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Don Juan Is Hell: Diane paints an unflattering picture of Sam when she uses him as a case study in her psychology class. Woody challenges Carla to a sports trivia quiz.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Cheers
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Fools and Their Money: Sam decides to protect Woody from wasting his money by not placing a risky bet on his behalf, but when the long shot romps home, Sam's forced to pay up.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Baggage: Ray and Debra get involved in a two-week battle of wills over who's responsible for putting away a suitcase.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: The Bachelor Party: Debra and Marie make Raymond feel guilty when they find out that the bachelor party he hosted for Robert was a huge disappointment.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Frasier
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Dark Victory: After counselling his family and friends when all he wants is a little peace, Frasier comes to realise that sometimes you have to put others first.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Frasier
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: She's the Boss: Frasier and the new station boss get on like oil and water - especially when she moves his show to 2am.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Live: Sunday Brunch
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Lee Mack chats about the 20th anniversary of Not Going Out. Emma Sidi talks about the new series of SNL UK. Plus: Russell T Davies, Sarah Solemani, KayCee Stroh and Everyone Says Hi.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: To Cur with Love: Homer loses Santa's Little Helper but doesn't seem to care, until Grampa tells the story of Homer's long-lost childhood pup Bongo.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Simpsons
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: King-Size Homer: Homer tries to put on enough weight to be classified as disabled so that he can work from home.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: The Dog House
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Rocky the bulldog has had a much-needed facelift for his date, but only has eyes for a toy avocado. Muddy puddle enthusiast Grady the lurcher is looking for a new thrill.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: A couple create an ambitious floating home, George and Will make a magical vista in their garden flat, and two siblings build their own mobile homes away from home.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Worst House on the Street
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: In London, Stuart and Scarlette help Colin and Audrey, whose five-bed Balham home needs a complete overhaul to be in with any chance of appealing to a modern-day family.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Channel 4 News
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Channel 4's flagship news programme. Including the weather.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: F1 Singapore GP Highlights
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Verstappen had a cracking weekend in Malaysia. Can he do it again in the steaming humidity and tight turns of Marina Bay? P4-6 are tight, so he could climb in the standings if he does.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: New: Celebrity Pottery Throw Down
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: It's the final, and the celebs create a trifle set and a tricky throwing surprise challenge. Who'll taste sweet success, and who'll get their just desserts? (Ep5/5)

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: New: Apocalypse: Could You...
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: ...Survive?: A new survivor arrives in the West and a battle of the sexes breaks out. There are also cereal wars. And tempers flare as Bertie makes some accusations. (Ep5)

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Gogglebox
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: What's the Gogglebox verdict on this week's TV?

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Geordie Coppers
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: A manhunt begins when a bad batch of spice hits the streets. PC Siobhan searches for a known burglar. And PC Sherrie encounters two homeless lovebirds. (Ep4)

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: 999: On the Front Line
channel4south.uk.plus1.description: Paramedics treat a woman showing signs of a stroke, a mum who has terrible pain in her face and a woman who has a swollen stomach and hasn't eaten for two days.

channel4south.uk.plus1.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell

itvgranada.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvgranada.uk.description: As the fifth series starts, we join the Fletchers adjusting to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Plans are in for the farmhouse rebuild following last year's fire, and as they await the green light, there's plenty to keep them busy. Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the 120 acres five years ago, and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: EFL Championship - Southampton v Portsmouth
itvgranada.uk.description: Hugh Woozencroft presents live EFL action from the Championship as Southampton take on Portsmouth in the south-coast derby at St Mary's Stadium. Southampton have been in excellent form at home this season, winning all four of their league games at St Mary's, but local rivals Pompey will be confident of getting a result after heading into the international break unbeaten in their last three games. Last season neither side was able to claim local bragging rights. (Football)

Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
itv1anglia.uk.description: S13 E4 Bradley Walsh presents as Richard Bacon, Daisy Arwen Campbell, Neil Jones and Gary Wilmot pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Win Win
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E3 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Voice UK
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2026 E7 Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through the toughest challenge yet. Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E6 Festive edition of the comedy game show in which celebrities team up with family members, with the parents choosing which questions their grown-up children will answer and gambling on how many they can get right. Featuring Larry Lamb and his son George, Motsi Mabuse and her mum Dudu, and Josh Widdicombe and his dad Tom competing for charity while, as ever, Romesh's mum Shanthi keeps score and brings extra festive banter.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather

itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E11 Action from the latest matches, including Swansea City v Norwich City at Swansea.com Stadium, Middlesbrough v Wolverhampton Wanderers at Riverside Stadium and West Bromwich Albion v Birmingham City at The Hawthorns in the Championship.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E7 South Donegal Dermot O'Leary heads to the west of Co Donegal for a crash course in the Irish language at Glencolmcille Folk Village, before putting his lesson to the test by ordering a pint in a local pub. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a professional.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E1 Effortless One Pan Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook, beginning with four of her favourite one-pan dishes . She makes broccoli salmon noodles and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta, and shares the tricks to make her pear, thyme and brie tart. She then picks greens from the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she makes in her pickling shed to share with her husband Harry Herbert.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E1 Return of the documentary following Kelvin Fletcher and his family, joining them as they adjust to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the farm five years ago and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. Lambing gets underway and, after a tricky start, the ewes are producing some of the biggest and healthiest lambs they've ever had.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E25 Actor Michael Brandon, actress Caroline Harker and Antony Costa and Duncan James of Blue join Alan, while Camilla Bassett-Smith takes viewer' gardening questions in Trowels and Tribulations. Rum is the order of the day in today's Best of British, and there is the incredible story of a 15-year-old horse back competing after losing its sight.

itv1anglia.uk.title: EFL Live : Southampton v Portsmouth 11.10
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E3 Southampton v Portsmouth (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents all the action from the south coast derby in the Championship, held at St Mary's Stadium. Both meetings between the rivals last term ended in draws, but the Saints will be hoping to maintain their 100 per cent home record this term, as they look to continue climbing up the table after being docked four points at the start of the campaign due to the 'Spygate' scandal. With analysis from Matt Taylor and Francis Benali, commentary by Joe Speight and Iain Dowie, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E1 Family Favourites Emma Willis and Tom Allen return with the contest as 12 famous faces are each mentored by a chef to compete in culinary battles over 10 weeks. The first head-to-head showdown is between actress Caroline Quentin, Gladiators star Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Emmerdale actor Mark Charnock as they attempt to deliver classic family favourites. One contestant will go straight through to the next round, while the other two face each other in the dreaded cook off, after which one of them will leave the competition.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Celebrity Lingo

itv1anglia.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

UAndGold+1.uk.title: Gavin & Stacey

stvnorth.uk.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
stvnorth.uk.description: S13 E4 Bradley Walsh presents as Richard Bacon, Daisy Arwen Campbell, Neil Jones and Gary Wilmot pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

stvnorth.uk.title: Win Win
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E3 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Voice UK
stvnorth.uk.description: S2026 E7 Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through the toughest challenge yet. Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

stvnorth.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E6 Festive edition of the comedy game show in which celebrities team up with family members, with the parents choosing which questions their grown-up children will answer and gambling on how many they can get right. Featuring Larry Lamb and his son George, Motsi Mabuse and her mum Dudu, and Josh Widdicombe and his dad Tom competing for charity while, as ever, Romesh's mum Shanthi keeps score and brings extra festive banter.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E80 10/10/2026 - 3 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: English Football League Highlights : 10/10/2026
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E11 Action from the latest matches, including Swansea City v Norwich City at Swansea.com Stadium, Middlesbrough v Wolverhampton Wanderers at Riverside Stadium and West Bromwich Albion v Birmingham City at The Hawthorns in the Championship.

stvnorth.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E7 South Donegal Dermot O'Leary heads to the west of Co Donegal for a crash course in the Irish language at Glencolmcille Folk Village, before putting his lesson to the test by ordering a pint in a local pub. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a professional.

stvnorth.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Effortless One Pan Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook, beginning with four of her favourite one-pan dishes . She makes broccoli salmon noodles and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta, and shares the tricks to make her pear, thyme and brie tart. She then picks greens from the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she makes in her pickling shed to share with her husband Harry Herbert.

stvnorth.uk.title: Unwind with STV
stvnorth.uk.description: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

stvnorth.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E1 Return of the documentary following Kelvin Fletcher and his family, joining them as they adjust to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the farm five years ago and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. Lambing gets underway and, after a tricky start, the ewes are producing some of the biggest and healthiest lambs they've ever had.

Rum is the order of the day in today's Best of British, and there is the incredible story of a 15-year-old horse back competing after losing its sight.

stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E3 Southampton v Portsmouth (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents all the action from the south coast derby in the Championship, held at St Mary's Stadium. Both meetings between the rivals last term ended in draws, but the Saints will be hoping to maintain their 100 per cent home record this term, as they look to continue climbing up the table after being docked four points at the start of the campaign due to the 'Spygate' scandal. With analysis from Matt Taylor and Francis Benali, commentary by Joe Speight and Iain Dowie, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E1 Family Favourites Emma Willis and Tom Allen return with the contest as 12 famous faces are each mentored by a chef to compete in culinary battles over 10 weeks. The first head-to-head showdown is between actress Caroline Quentin, Gladiators star Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Emmerdale actor Mark Charnock as they attempt to deliver classic family favourites. One contestant will go straight through to the next round, while the other two face each other in the dreaded cook off, after which one of them will leave the competition.

stvnorth.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. together.uk.title: Garden Rescue - Congleton
together.uk.description: Poor old Marie - her small garden with its high walls and boring lawn is so imposing, it's more of a prison yard than a pretty plot. After Marie chooses Chris's design. it's on with turning the new build plot into a bit of country charm. (Home improvement, House/garden, Reality) - 2024

babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a thermometer and band aids! Help fix butterfly's torn wing and see him fly again! S1 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles stars and a spaceship! Help use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a diving mask and a boat! Help save Sketch from a pink octopus under the sea!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they find creative ways to play games with a bowl and stick, dancing and spinning the bowl just like in the circus!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they use building blocks and sticks to create a wonderful game of limbo! So how low can you go? S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: What a pleasant surprise - there's a rubber duck in the yard! Butterson finds himself stranded in the middle of a puddle on the fubber duck.

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Beep Beep! Olly is a bus driver today! He's taking Dolly to school, Snail to the market and Kitty to work.

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Join Needles as he meets his friends in the desert. Come and race with Cloudy, hop with Hoppy and sing along with Lale the Ukulele.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Joe the monkey loves to monkey around. Come join him in the jungle and follow in his steps - clap your hands, stomp your feet and scratch your head.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Ready to run, jump, hop turn around and touch the ground? Then get yourself a rabbit and come join me!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Let's be an elephant for a day! Wave your ears, wag your tail and lift your trunk!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie and Number Six on their search for the missing ingredient for the never-ending cake.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he helps Number Seven find musicians for a seven-member orchestra before they all set out to have fun singing and dancing.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he tries to help Number Eight find eight sheep that disappeared from his story with the help of a surprise friend-the green dragon.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Circle play hide and seek. Circle is very good at hiding, will Charlie be able to find him?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: All aboard! Captain Trapezoid and Charlie are going sailing. Oh no! Captain Trapezoid has forgotten his sails.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Blue triangle and Orange triangle's ball gets stuck in a tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play what is hiding beneath the handkerchief, the animal game, and imaginary games.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: It's time to play fun games with Teeny and Tiny. Join mischievous friends as they learn colors, numbers, sizes, and shapes!

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Painting is fun, especially when painting the sun! Join Teeny and Tiny as they sing together, play games, and solve riddles!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Birthday cakes! Play the sound game to hear a harp's sound! What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? A shoe!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: At a picnic! Help Hippa find the missing part to complete the light bulb. Join Sophie to find out which color matches the sun. Yellow, of course!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader a teddy bear, a lamp, a pillow and a book. Now they're ready for bed!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader a cake, balloons, a hat and candles. Let the party begin!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader shoes, a bowling pin, a mat and a ball. Who wants to bowl?!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little penguin doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw his paper biscuit bag. The animals have a great time playing their instruments.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of bears cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Bear has brought Elephant.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Bear get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola as she has fun on the farm. Play with rabbit and foal and see who is near and far! See how bull helps calf reach the oranges!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has long ears! Come along and learn which animal has a long tail and a mane!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she sees which animal has a red crest! Come along and learn which animal has wings and orange feet!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a beaver and his son by the lake! Come watch them cut down a tree with their teeth!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a magical chameleon! At first he's green and then he's brown!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a sleepy dormouse! Find out that the dormouse sleeps throughout the entire winter!

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry take care of a tortoise egg until it hatches. The bring it clothes, toys, dolls and even a trampoline! Will it hatch?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix wants to play, but sleepy Leo doesn't want to wake up. No matter how hard Pix tries, Leo is intent on napping. Will Leo finally wake up to play?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli and Leela find the perfect muddy mud slide but they can't persuade Gray to join in the fun. Will he be able to overcome his fear?

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A shovel arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused shovel discover its true use? S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A key arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused key discover its true use? S3 Ep8

babytv.uk.description: A net arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused net discover its true use? S3 Ep9

babytv.uk.description: Tommy is having a hard time keeping his balance while riding a bike.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Bunny is looking for something to cool her down while she rides her bicycle. Leave it up to Mikey to find a solution. S1 Ep12

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Johnny dresses up as a brave knight and wants a suitable costume for his bicycle as well. Will Mikey be able to help him out?

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they use a chalkstone to draw arrows and signs and play follow me!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Rabbit is great at doing magic tricks. Will Baby butterfly be able to be a true magician? Join them as they have fun pulling surprises out of hats. S1 Ep19

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Hippo have planned a day at the beach together. But once they get there, Hippo disappears. Come join Baby as he looks for Hippo. S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby helps Turtle look for the loud sound that was keeping him up at night. Was it Giraffe playing the drums? Squirrel eating acorns? Come find out! S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie looks for the ball in the water and sees another elephant copying his movements! Ducky and Froggy see a duck and frog in the water too!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Come have fun with bubbles in the tub! Froggy has a bubble head, Ellie gets a bubble beard and Ducky looks like a sheep!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie and Froggy are planning a surprise birthday party for Ducky! Help hang balloons and decorate the cake!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Come play ball and see it turn into a hot air balloon! Join the ride, float on fluffy clouds and slide down a sparkling rainbow!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: What's inside the box? A beautiful red shoe! Join the friends as they set out on a journey in a shoe that turns into a car!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they use a cardboard box as a rocket ship! Set out on an exciting adventure into outer space!

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Join Uh Oh, Tickles and Yum Yum as they all go to Dodo's house and enjoy delicious soup that Yum Yum prepared!

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Uh Oh gets stuck on the roof while cleaning the window. The friends try to help but get stuck as well.

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Dodo's art exhibition is on. His friends pick out beautiful paintings as a presents and Dodo misses his art paintings. S1 Ep15

amc.us.title: Gremlins
amc.us.description: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the "mogwai" but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve. (Holiday, Fantasy, Thriller, Comedy, Horror) - 1984

amc.us.title: The Fly
amc.us.description: When scientist Seth Brundle completes his teleportation device, he decides to test its abilities on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a housefly slips in during the process, leading to a merger of man and insect. Initially, Brundle appears to have undergone a successful teleportation, but the fly's cells begin to take over his body. As he becomes increasingly fly-like, Brundle's girlfriend is horrified as the person she once loved deteriorates into a monster. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

amc.us.title: The Thing
amc.us.description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: Tremors
amc.us.description: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh. (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

amc.us.title: Cujo
amc.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

amc.us.title: Anaconda
amc.us.description: Filmmaker Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez) is traveling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it. (Thriller) - 1997

amc.us.title: Creepshow
amc.us.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

amc.us.title: Silver Bullet
amc.us.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: Children of the Corn
amc.us.description: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity. (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: Misery
amc.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

amc.us.title: Carrie
amc.us.description: High school can be tough for many teenagers, but for Carrie White (Chloë Grace Moretz), it's especially hellish. A shy and awkward teen being raised by a religious zealot (Julianne Moore), Carrie is frequently the target of bullies. But Carrie has a secret talent: She can make things move with her mind. One fateful night, an especially cruel prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge, and Carrie unleashes her telekinetic powers on all who get in her way. (Horror) - 2013

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.description: The fifth installment of the popular franchise focuses on Alice (Lisa Wilcox), a survivor of the fourth, who believes Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) has been eliminated for good. mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Central ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

motortrend.us.title: Wheeler Dealers - Ford Fiesta Mk1
motortrend.us.description: To celebrate Wheeler Dealers' 20th anniversary, Mike and Elvis mark another motoring milestone: the end of production for the Ford Fiesta; the boys take on the restoration of a Mark 1; they're soon worried they've bitten off more than they can chew. (Auto, Reality, How-to) - 2023-10-16

motortrend.us.title: Wheeler Dealers - Peugeot 205
motortrend.us.description: A ride in a Peugeot 205 T16 inspires Mike's latest mission to buy a 205 Rallye; it's the UK version and is under-powered compared to European models, but Mike reckons Elvis can easily upgrade the engine to beat its Eurospec counterpart. (Auto, Reality, How-to) - 2023-10-23

motortrend.us.description: Mike and Elvis are massive fans of turbocharged Subarus, and they're both baffled the company never produced a Scooby BRZ STI; the pair are going to make one themselves, using the newest car Mike bought on Wheeler Dealers. (Auto, Reality, How-to) - 2023-11-06

motortrend.us.title: Wheeler Dealers - Ford P100

Her life takes a turn for the unexpected when, at a garden party for her fiancé and herself, she spots a certain white rabbit and tumbles down a hole after him. Reunited with her friends the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat and others, Alice learns it is her destiny to end the Red Queen's reign of terror. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2010

fx.us.title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
fx.us.description: After slipping through a mirror, Alice (Mia Wasikowska) finds herself back in Underland with the White Queen (Anne Hathaway), the Cheshire Cat, the White Rabbit, Tweedledee and Tweedledum. Her friends tell her that the Mad Hatter (Johnny Depp) is in a funk over the loss of his family. Hoping to save his loved ones, Alice steals the Chronosphere from Time (Sacha Baron Cohen) to travel into the past. While there, she encounters the younger Hatter and the evil Red Queen (Helena Bonham Carter). (Fantasy, Adventure, Animated) - 2016

fx.us.title: Hocus Pocus
fx.us.description: After moving to Salem, Mass., teenager Max Dennison (Omri Katz) explores an abandoned house with his sister Dani (Thora Birch) and their new friend, Allison (Vinessa Shaw). After dismissing a story Allison tells as superstitious, Max accidentally frees a coven of evil witches (Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy) who used to live in the house. Now, with the help of a magical cat, the kids must steal the witches' book of spells to stop them from becoming immortal. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

fx.us.title: Hocus Pocus 2

fx.us.title: Edward Scissorhands
fx.us.description: A scientist (Vincent Price) builds an animated human being -- the gentle Edward (Johnny Depp). The scientist dies before he can finish assembling Edward, though, leaving the young man with a freakish appearance accentuated by the scissor blades he has instead of hands. Loving suburban saleswoman Peg (Dianne Wiest) discovers Edward and takes him home, where he falls for Peg's teen daughter (Winona Ryder). However, despite his kindness and artistic talent, Edward's hands make him an outcast. (Holiday, Fantasy, Comedy drama, Romance, Drama) - 1990

own.us.title: Love and Marriage: Huntsville
own.us.description: S12 E05 Martell's Destiny? Martell and Arionne confront Marsau and Tisha about breaking their truce after Tisha doubled down on rumors about Martell. Arionne calls Destiny a snake and wants Martell to stay away from her.

own.us.title: Family or Fiancé

own.us.title: Family or Fiancé

own.us.title: House Hunters
own.us.description: S229 E10 Plumbing Perils in Worcester Newlyweds are on a search to find a home to start their family in Worcester, Mass.; both are hard to please; with their contrasting styles and his interest in plumbing, they may run out of options.

own.us.title: House Hunters

own.us.title: House Hunters International

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 1
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Edwin Diaz and Kyle Tucker join the team at Camelback Ranch as the Dodgers prepare for the 2026 season. Roki Sasaki reflects on the ups and downs of his rookie season including his postseason success as a reliever.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 2
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Miguel Rojas and Clayton Kershaw are mic'd up as they receive their 2025 World Series championship rings. The Dodgers head back to Toronto where Rojas and Andy Pages relive their biggest World Series moments.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 3
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Relief pitcher Will Klein shows off his love for Magic the Gathering and Mookie Betts gives Backstage an inside look at his latest hobby.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 4
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: An all-access look at outfielder Teoscar Hernandez as he works to get back on the field following a hamstring injury. Plus, a look into Hernandez's life at home as he recalls his son's diagnosis of Autism.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 5
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: From his early coaching days in San Diego to three-time World Series champion manager, Backstage takes an in-depth look at Dave Roberts' coaching career as he gets his 1,000th win as a major league manager.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 6
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Two-time Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal is acquired at the trade deadline and makes his Dodger debut. Behind the scenes with Dodgers legend Orel Hershiser as he receives his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 7
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Dodgers prospect Josue De Paula is mic'd up as he joins the team in Cincinnati. The Dodgers clinch their 13th NL West division title in the last 14 seasons.

The U.S. government keeps the crisis under wraps, but crack reporter Jenny Lerner (Tea Leoni) uncovers the truth -- forcing U.S. President Beck (Morgan Freeman) to announce his plan. Grizzled astronaut Spurgeon "Fish" Tanner (Robert Duvall) and his team will land on the comet and lay explosives, hopefully deterring the object from its doomsday course. If not, humanity will have to prepare for the worst. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Drama, Thriller) - 1998

sundancetv.us.title: Road House
sundancetv.us.description: The Double Deuce is the meanest, loudest and rowdiest bar south of the Mason-Dixon Line, and Dalton (Patrick Swayze) has been hired to clean it up. He might not look like much, but the Ph.D.-educated bouncer proves he's more than capable -- busting the heads of troublemakers and turning the roadhouse into a jumping hot-spot. But Dalton's romance with the gorgeous Dr. Clay (Kelly Lynch) puts him on the bad side of cutthroat local big shot Brad Wesley (Ben Gazzara). (Action, Thriller) - 1989

sundancetv.us.title: Dante's Peak

(Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 1997

actionmax.us.title: Batman Forever
actionmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
actionmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

actionmax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
actionmax.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Man
actionmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Masterminds
actionmax.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
actionmax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Trap
actionmax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
actionmax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Contagion
actionmax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Night on Earth
actionmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: All Eyez on Me
actionmax.us.description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Inconceivable
actionmax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
actionmax.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
actionmax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Cleaner
actionmax.us.description: Hoping to expose corruption, radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. Their cause soon gets hijacked by an extremist within their ranks who's ready to kill everyone. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Tomb Raider
actionmax.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Rover
actionmax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: Robin Hood
actionmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
actionmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

actionmax.us.title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
actionmax.us.description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals. (Special, Documentary, Nature) - 2022-02-27

actionmax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
actionmax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Epic
cinemax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Mojave
cinemax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Arctic
cinemax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Pan
cinemax.us.description: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Beirut
cinemax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Perfect Match
cinemax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Spring Breakers

However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek

Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Rampage

When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers.
