shoxbetwest.us.title: The Violent Heart
shoxbetwest.us.description: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. (Thriller, Drama) - 2020

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Scream 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Scream 3
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. (Horror, Comedy, Mystery) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: It Follows
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Venom
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeshowcase.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. (Drama) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Piranha
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Cured
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. (Horror, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass 3
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Tale of the Mummy
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help. (Horror) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Failure to Launch
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance) - 2006

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Smart People
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2008

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: A Simple Plan
showtimeshowcase.us.description: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Mexican
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Kingpin
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Old School

He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. (Comedy) - 2011

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. (Comedy) - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: Number Two

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa

Based on the "Jackass" TV series. (Comedy) - 2013

When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Firm

The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension

After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Yards

So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. (Crime drama) - 2000

showtimeextreme.us.title: Patriot Games
showtimeextreme.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

showtimeextreme.us.title: Fist Fight

Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jack Reacher
showtimeextreme.us.description: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
showtimeextreme.us.description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. (Action, Thriller) - 2016

At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War) - 2007

showtimeextreme.us.title: Killer Joe
showtimeextreme.us.description: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2011

showtimeextreme.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimeextreme.us.description: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. (Thriller, Horror) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Phantoms
showtimeextreme.us.description: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimeextreme.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. (Thriller) - 2022

showtimeextreme.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimeextreme.us.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Tale of the Mummy
showtimeextreme.us.description: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help. (Horror) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Colossal

When news reports surface that a giant creature is destroying Seoul, South Korea, Gloria gradually comes to the realization that she is somehow connected to this far-off phenomenon. As events begin to spiral out of control, she must figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. (Comedy drama, Fantasy) - 2016

showtimeextreme.us.title: Hostage
showtimeextreme.us.description: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. (Action, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeextreme.us.title: Se7en
showtimeextreme.us.description: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

showtimeextreme.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimeextreme.us.description: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. (War, Historical drama, Action) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Troy
showtimeextreme.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon, having already defeated every army in Greece, uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy, the last kingdom preventing his control over the Aegean Sea. (Adventure, War, Action, Historical drama) - 2004

showtimeextreme.us.title: Noah
showtimeextreme.us.description: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood. (Historical drama, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimeextreme.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 1994

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Saint
showtimeextreme.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. (Action) - 1997

showtimeextreme.us.title: Jacob's Ladder
showtimeextreme.us.description: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness. (Horror, Drama, Thriller) - 1990

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Core
showtimeextreme.us.description: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

showtimeextreme.us.title: Run & Gun
showtimeextreme.us.description: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

showtimeextreme.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeextreme.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. skycinemafamily.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Wizard of Oz
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Charlotte's Web
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Golden Compass
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wicked: For Good
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Witches
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

starzcinema.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. starzcinema.us.description: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

starzcinema.us.title: Quartet
starzcinema.us.description: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice. (Comedy drama) - 2012

starzencoreaction.us.title: Highlander II: Renegade Version

(Fantasy, Adventure) - 1991

But when Doug's nemesis, Anders Cain, is made captain of the Highlanders and new ownership threatens to tear his team apart, Doug is compelled back into action. (Comedy) - 2017

Awakening after more than a decade, Selene discovers that Michael is dead, but that she has given birth to his daughter, Eve. Shunned by nearly all surviving vampires, save one, even Selene seems powerless against her latest opponent: a genetically enhanced lycan. (Fantasy, Action, Horror) - 2012

When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills. (Fantasy, Horror, Action) - 2011

(Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

starzencoreaction.us.title: Paranormal Activity
starzencoreaction.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. themoviechannel.us.title: The Gift
themoviechannel.us.description: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter
themoviechannel.us.description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (Thriller) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Kiss the Girls
themoviechannel.us.description: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy 3: The Ascent
themoviechannel.us.description: Danyael is the offspring of an angel and a mortal woman. After being gunned down in a seemingly fatal shooting, he rises from the dead and realizes he possesses great powers. The evil angels Pyriel and Zophael then set out to convince Danyael to do their bidding and help wreak havoc on the planet. But former angel Gabriel, who was cast down to earth in human form, tries to sway Danyael toward the path of righteousness. (Horror) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy IV: Uprising
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman (Kari Wuhrer) must protect an ancient religious manuscript from renegade angels. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Daniela Forever
themoviechannel.us.description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. (Science fiction, Romance) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
themoviechannel.us.description: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync. (Romance, Drama, Science fiction) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Lovely Bones
themoviechannel.us.description: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The English Patient
themoviechannel.us.description: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Untouchables
themoviechannel.us.description: After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice. (Crime drama) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Million Dollar Baby
themoviechannel.us.description: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. (Drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island. (Thriller, Action, Historical drama) - 1979

themoviechannel.us.title: The Mechanic

Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The Snowman

As the vicious murders continue, Harry teams up with a brilliant recruit to try and lure the madman out of the shadows before he can strike again. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crow

On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission. (Action, Fantasy) - 1994

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Funny Lady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this sequel to "Funny Girl," Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) is now a huge star on Broadway whose fortunes have taken a hit from the Great Depression. After a whirlwind romance, Fanny marries Billy Rose (James Caan), and the two agree to collaborate on a show. Despite the show's early struggles, Fanny makes it a success, but the sudden fame puts a strain on her marriage -- especially when Billy learns she still has feelings for her ex-husband, Nick (Omar Sharif). (Musical comedy) - 1975

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Giant
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wealthy Texas rancher Bick Benedict (Rock Hudson) shakes things up at home when he returns from a trip to the East Coast with a love interest, the refined Leslie Lynnton (Elizabeth Taylor). Bick and Leslie get married, but she clashes with his sister, Luz (Mercedes McCambridge), and wins the admiration of the ambitious young Jett Rink (James Dean). Bick and Jett form a tense rivalry that continues to surface as the years pass and fortunes change in this sweeping drama. (Drama) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Asphalt Jungle
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Recently released from prison, Dix Handley concocts a plan to steal $1 million in jewels. Dix gathers a team of small-time crooks, including a safecracker and a lawyer, and the heist is a success until a stray bullet kills one of the men. As they scramble to pick up the pieces after the theft, the men let their greed get the best of them while entangling themselves in webs of deceit, treachery and murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Nights of Cabiria
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The magnificent Giulietta Masina (Fellini's wife) plays an eternally optimistic Rome streetwalker with a heart of gold and a head of cotton candy in her husband's Oscar-winning masterpiece. This funny, poignant classic inspired the musical "Sweet Charity" and is a must-see for Fellini fans. (Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Crime Wave
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Former jail mates make it difficult for a paroled man, hounded by a suspicious detective, to go straight. (Crime drama) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: S.O.B.
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Felix Farmer (Richard Mulligan) is a Hollywood director well on his way to killing his career. He just spent $30 million making a musical that no one wants to see. But, after several botched suicide attempts, the filmmaker has a sudden epiphany: Why not turn his moribund family-friendly entertainment into a porn movie? Of course, to make his scheme work, Felix will have to convince his actress wife, Sally Miles (Julie Andrews), to bare it all for the camera. (Comedy) - 1981

A successful, middle-aged Hollywood songwriter falls hopelessly in love with the woman of his dreams, and even follows the girl and her new husband to their Mexican honeymoon resort. While his behavior seems sure to land him in trouble, out of the blue fate plays into his hands. (Romantic comedy) - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lust for Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This lauded drama depicts the life of revered Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh. An intense and imaginative artist, van Gogh possesses undeniable talent, but he is plagued by mental problems and frustrations with failure. Supported by his brother, Theo, the tormented van Gogh eventually leaves Holland for France, where he meets volatile fellow painter Paul Gauguin and struggles to find greater inspiration. (Biography) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Naked Kiss

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dead Ringer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Identical twin sisters Margaret (Bette Davis) and Edith Philips (also Davis) haven't spoken in nearly 20 years, ever since Margaret hoodwinked the man Edith loved into marrying her instead. When Margaret's husband dies, Edith reunites with her twin -- but only to seek revenge. Killing her sister and stealing her identity, Edith has everyone convinced she's really Margaret. But when she encounters Margaret's lover, Tony (Peter Lawford), Edith uncovers a shocking secret that threatens her plans. (Mystery) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad Seed
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Air Force Colonel Kenneth Penmark (William Hopper) and his wife, Christine (Nancy Kelly), dote on their pig-tailed daughter, Rhoda (Patty McCormack) -- as does their lonely landlady, Monica Breedlove (Evelyn Varden). But self-centered Rhoda has a secret tendency for selfishness and loves to accumulate gifts, whether given or stolen, in her room. Christine keeps her knowledge of her daughter's darker side to herself, but when a schoolmate of Rhoda's dies mysteriously, her self-deception unravels. (Horror) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Colors: Red

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Tugboat Annie

Annie's son, Alec (Robert Young), an industrious student, becomes the youngest ship's master on the Pacific Coast and gets engaged to his boss' daughter. Terry continues to drink heavily, causing an accident in his stupor that makes Alice lose her boat. Angry with his father, Alec refuses to talk to his parents until, in trouble at sea, he needs their help. (Comedy drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Emma

When Smith takes Emma on a vacation, he makes his feelings for her known by proposing marriage. Emma happily accepts, but tragedy strikes when Smith dies of a heart attack shortly after. Emma is devastated, but then must face Smith's children, who suspect she may have been involved in the death of their father. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love Me Tonight
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this stylish musical comedy, Maurice Courtelin (Maurice Chevalier), a French tailor, travels to the castle of nearby royalty to collect payment on long overdue bills. A series of mishaps force Courtelin to pose as a baron while he tries to woo the elegant Princess Jeanette (Jeanette MacDonald). Resistant to Courtelin's charms at first, she eventually becomes intrigued by him. However, when the truth gets out about Courtelin's humble identity, he risks losing the only woman that he loves. (Musical comedy) - 1932

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Last Christmas With the spectacular new fish market nearing completion, the old market stages its final Christmas marathon. As record crowds descend, retailers battle shortages.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Episode 7 Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Tasty Tapas Marcus is exploring one of the most popular ways of eating in the whole of Spain and finding out how Mallorca does tapes differently. He starts with a visit to the hugely popular El Camino in Palma.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A New Zealand Food Story
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Episode 4 Ben's meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal-led apple juice, using the best technology in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Cream First, Fry Later And Fruit Last On eating dirty, David eats a Sicilian breakfast that would leave any mere mortal no room for lunch or dinner.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Jamaican Beef Pot Pie Chef Deborah VanTrece elevates the classic Jamaican beef patty by giving it a Southern twist and turning it into a delicious pot pie.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 Unlocking Florida's Keys Gordon Ramsay dives, rappels, kayaks, forages, and fishes on an all-out action global adventure in search of the world's most incredible food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Torres Strait At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E1 Pickled Octopus Torres Strait Islander chef and owner of Mabu Mabu, Nornie Bero, cooks and talks through some of her favourite easy recipes, from quick picked octopus to fresh baked damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Seville In Seville, James visits the local food market and has breakfast at a secret bar. He visits an orange grove to make marmalade, then cooks mackerel, pork belly, crema catalana and BBQ duck.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Amalul's Pandan Bubble Tea Amalul, Alimah's granddaughter, is a self-proclaimed bubble tea connoisseur. She shares her bright bubble tea brew and pays tribute to the vibrant and flavourful pandanus leaf.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Yes, Chef!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 The Pursuit Of Perfection The chefs make a dish worthy of a high-end restaurant that shows off their creativity and technique, but they won't be cooking these dishes themselves.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Pousse-Pied In Spain's Galicia, fishermen sometimes risk their lives for a few kilos. Accidents, strictly controlled fishing, theft and smuggling complete the portrait.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: River Cottage: Veg
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Power Hugh whips up a delicious vegetarian pasta dish to feed a group of outdoor swimmers. Plus, he makes a tasty stew with duck eggs, paprika and saffron.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Episode 1 Paula shows us her version of cullen skink soup with a hunk of cheese and scallion soda bread on the side. She heads to Cushendun beach, to share tips on how to barbecue the perfect pork shoulder.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Frugal Foodie
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 ONE Pot Wonders Save time and cleanup with one-pot meals like One Pan Mozzarella Meatball Subs, a One Pan Greek Chicken Bake, and an Avocado Gnocchi with Spinach & Pinenuts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luke Nguyen's Memories Of Street Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luke starts his street food adventure in the chaotic streets of Saigon with a traditional Vietnamese pork breakfast before heading down the street and getting wowed by a local doughnut stall.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Pugila This week Jamie heads to glorious Puglia to seek out family recipes that make this spectacular region the hottest food destination in Italy. Jamie meets Puglia's real pasta grannies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E11 Blake Lively Prue welcomes Hollywood actress Blake Lively who cooks a Kale Caesar salad. John visits Tewkesbury to meet the artists behind the town's banners, and John and Prue cook up a potato rosti breakfast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cadiz James is shown around Cadiz by Jose Pizarro. They visit the food market and Sherry Triangle, then eat by the sea. James explores the salt flats and they cook at Jose's villa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Winter Salads A quick trip around Jamie's vegetable garden produces an army of colourful ingredients to make inspired winter salads.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E6 Eggs And My Chickens As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She recollects those memories and creates a medley of ingredients for chopped salad, chicken cacciatore, and potato egg frico.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E6 Paquime & Pecans Pati visits a haven of Chihuahuan culture and learns what makes their pecans so delicious.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Vegetables Mark makes vegetables the star and shows us how to treat them with care and attention to let their glorious flavours shine. Making pot roast cauliflower, vegetable dahl, and some tricks with beetroot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Sonia Harwood With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Planting Roots In Tijuana Mexico Local, regular, newcomer -- whoever you are, Tijuana has something delicious for you to eat. Grab a seat and try the craft beer, pork belly tacos, and Caesar salad. Trust us, you'll want to stay.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Broome: Ali & Mitch Mushroom Chicken with Vermicelli and Gubinge Custard - Mushroom and Chicken is a popular dish in Kriol cooking. Handed down by families who had a Chinese connection, this dish has many variations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Ryfylke: Vikings, Jazz, And Herring Dive into the diverse culture of Ryfylke, where Viking history, jazz festivals, and seafood culture intersect.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E11 Episode 11 Award-winning chef Mod joins Laura in the market to make delicious Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls. Laura then whips up a naughty Tim Tam Doughnut, followed by a guilt-free Carrot Banana Cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Ramen Around Tuscany Rachael prepares a hearty and healthy meal for her Italian friends, combining storebought and homemade ingredients to make flavourful, protein-rich ramen bowls.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Mornington Peninsula Hayden is on the Mornington Peninsula in Victoria where he catches up with his good friend Dani Venn for some local tips and adventure. Things start on the water with mussel farmer Harry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Episode 1 Ashley Alexander creates a gooey Vegan Caramel, Date and Fresh Ginger Self-Saucing Pudding that will leave you wanting more.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E6 Episode 6 of Season 9 Laura shares her easy homemade granola recipe; Catherine makes cauliflower hummus; Laura makes some chocolate truffles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Episode 4 Rick visits Cartmel in the Lake District, famous for its racecourse, its ancient 13th Century Priory and Jean Johns' sticky toffee pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E35 Episode 35 Guest Travis Harvey puts a twist on Spinach and Ricotta Fillo, while Justine prepares some Penne with Gorgonzola Speck and Walnuts, and Coconut Custard with Berries for dessert!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E68 Smart Choices Adam enlists two award-winning sustainability champions, chef Jo Barrett, and director Damon Gameau, to make a menu of smart choices.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Safety In Numbers It is Christmas, and Nigella is having a fabulous easy drinks party. On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Yorkshire In God's own country, Rick discovers the history of the Yorkshire pud and how best to make it. He visits the UK's biggest tofu factory and cooks delicious veggie dishes at home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Vinegar And Avocados Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in his bespoke vintage food truck in Andalucia to meet food producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marion Grasby's Flavours: Heart And Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Thai Street Food At Home Marion returns to Bangkok to share the street food favourites she craves when away - pork dumplings, chicken rice, and noodle soup - then shows how to recreate these comforting dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Chicago Grandiose architecture, Italian Beef, Cubs versus White Sox, taverns galore, and the best meat in tube form in all of America find their way into Tony's layover.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hokkaido Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Ringkobing, Denmark Ringkobing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visits a traditional Herring Festival.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E8 Frontios: Part 2 Trying to discover why Frontios is being attacked from both above and below, the Doctor faces the malevolent Tractators while revolution brews in the colony.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E9 Frontios: Part 3 Turlough’s race memories of the Frontios threaten to overwhelm him as the Doctor finally convinces Brazen that the threat from underground is very real.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E10 Frontios: Part: 4 The Doctor manipulates the Gravis into restoring the TARDIS, but still has to find a way to break the Tractators’ hold over Frontios before they wipe out all life on the surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E23 The Five Doctors The Doctor returns to Gallifrey only to discover that a deadly game banned and derelict for centuries, has been reactivated. Soon he finds his other selves have also been summoned to assist him in tracing the culprit and tracking down the secret Rassilon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E2 Warriors of the Deep: Part 2 The Silurians and Sea Devils send the Myrka in as a spearhead to the invasion of the Seabase, whilst Nilson and Doctor Solow work to bring the entire Bloc down.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E3 Warriors of the Deep: Part 3 As Vorshak’s crew are cut down one by one by Sauvix's Sea Devil Warriors, the Doctor is running out of ways to broker a peace between mammal and reptile.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E4 Warriors of the Deep: Part 4 Lethal hexachromite gas is used against the invaders and the Doctor is despondent that no one wants to find another way to avoid so much death.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E5 The Awakening: Part 1 Teacher Jane Hampden is increasingly frustrated by the war games being played around the village, but the Doctor is more alarmed to find a boy transported from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E6 The Awakening: Part 2 The Malus’s influence is asserting itself all over Little Hodcombe, and the war games take an unpleasant turn. The Doctor’s best defence is in the TARDIS - but the Malus is inside.

BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E7 Frontios: Part 1 Captain Revere is the latest person to be sucked beneath the ground on Frontios, leaving the young Plantagenet to run the colony. The Doctor’s TARDIS has also been destroyed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E8 Frontios: Part 2 Trying to discover why Frontios is being attacked from both above and below, the Doctor faces the malevolent Tractators while revolution brews in the colony.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E9 Frontios: Part 3 Turlough’s race memories of the Frontios threaten to overwhelm him as the Doctor finally convinces Brazen that the threat from underground is very real.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E10 Frontios: Part: 4 The Doctor manipulates the Gravis into restoring the TARDIS, but still has to find a way to break the Tractators’ hold over Frontios before they wipe out all life on the surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E22 The King's Demons: Part 2 The Master and the Doctor fight for control over Kamelion’s mind while Turlough and Tegan make new allies in the castle in an attempt to avoid the iron maiden.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E23 The Five Doctors The Doctor returns to Gallifrey only to discover that a deadly game banned and derelict for centuries, has been reactivated. BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E11 Resurrection of the Daleks: Part 1 Davros is held captive aboard a prison in space but the Daleks launch a rescue attempt.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E12 Resurrection of the Daleks: Part 2 As survivors of the prison station fight the invaders, Dalek agents on Earth take steps to protect the time corridor being used by the Doctor's friends.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E13 Planet of Fire: Part 1 On the planet Sarn, the truth about the god Logar is being searched for, while on Earth Peri wants a break from her stepfather. But the Master has other plans for everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E14 Planet of Fire: Part 2 Kamelion has taken the TARDIS to Sarn and is trying to locate his master, while the Doctor explores the mystery of the Misos Triangle - much to Turlough's consternation.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E15 Planet of Fire: Part 3 Logar is angry and the volcano shakes with his displeasure – according to Timanov, who demands sacrifices to appease his god. Peri discovers the Master's whereabouts.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E16 Planet of Fire: Part 4 The Doctor is forced to take drastic measures against Kamelion and the Master to stop Sarn being completely destroyed by the numismaton gas that has been released.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E17 The Caves of Androzani: Part 1 Gunrunners are on Androzani Minor, supplying the rebellious android-builder Sharez Jek with munitions to help his attempts to return to power. But not everyone is happy about that.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E18 The Caves of Androzani: Part 2 Military captive Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia and the only cure is the milk of the queen bat, who sleeps deep below the caverns.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E19 The Caves of Androzani: Part 3 As Morgus continues to plot his political future on Androzani Major, Sharez Jek insanely believes Peri will fall in love with him. The Doctor is caught by the gunrunners.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E20 The Caves of Androzani: Part 4 Morgus is ruined, exposed as the one funding Jek’s gunrunners, and Jek himself goes on a murderous rampage. Although dying from spectrox tomaemia the Doctor saves Peri.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E21 The Twin Dilemma: Part 1 The mysterious Professor Edgeworth has kidnapped twin human child genii, Romulus and Remus, and Hugo Lang holds the new Doctor responsible for the destruction of his spaceship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E22 The Twin Dilemma: Part 2 On Jaconda, Mestor’s cruel domination over the planet's population continues while on Titan Three, the Doctor seems to have been blown up in a booby-trapped building.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E23 The Twin Dilemma: Part 3 Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate his home planet but the Doctor knows there’s more to this than meets the eye.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E24 The Twin Dilemma: Part 4 Mestor’s true plan is revealed and the Doctor's old Gallifreyan friend Azmael comes to the realisation that he has been corrupted long enough by the Gastropod leader.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E1 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 1 The Cybermen are hiding in the London sewers and turning humans into semi-cybernetic slaves. On Telos two slaves make a bid of freedom and find a way to escape the planet for good.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E2 Attack of the Cybermen: Part 2 On Telos the Doctor is reintroduced to the Cyber Leader and meets the Cryons, the planet’s original inhabitants who want their planet back and will go to any lengths to do so.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E3 Vengeance on Varos: Part 1 Needing Zeiton 7 ore urgently for the TARDIS, the Doctor takes Peri to Varos, but quickly become part of the sadistic programming that entertains the populace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E4 Vengeance on Varos: Part 2 As Peri and Areta begin to transform into a bird and a reptile, the Doctor faces Sil, who has negotiated mining rights on Varos, depriving the Time Lord of what he needs...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E5 The Mark of the Rani: Part 1 People cannot sleep in the town of Killingworth and the Doctor realises it is the work of a renegade Time Lord, the Rani, who has teamed up with the Master to wreck chaos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E6 The Mark of the Rani: Part 2 George Stephenson and Luke Ward do their best to help the Doctor and Peri, but the Rani has other traps for the unwary, including the ability to turn people into trees...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S22 E7 The Two Doctors: Part 1 The Second Doctor and Jamie visit space station Camera to speak to the scientist Dastari, but the station has a saboteur aboard - Chessene is working with the Sontarans.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E24 How 'Bout Some Effort Cyborg goes to great lengths to make V-Day special for Jinx.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E12 Crocoduel Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E27 Distress Calls Jay and Nya contact Benthomaar at the harbor while Racer 7 and Vinny escort Cole through Ninjago City to broadcast a distress call to Princess Vania. Lloyd and Garmadon search the sewers for the missing Serpentine, and Lloyd believes his father might be a changed man after Garmadon spares the life of a crystal-infected Serpentine. Master Wu summons the Ninja back to the warehouse.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E28 An Issue of Trust The Ninja prepare to make their last stand as the crystal army closes in, while Lloyd and Garmadon take the fight to the Crystal King.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 The Hot Dog Dog! Our mystery-solving gang is in Chicago investigating the haunting of a historic hot dog factory.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Deep
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 The Proteus Factor Proteus, leader of the mysterious Guardians, traps the Aronnax in a magnetic field and kidnaps Ant, believing he is the key to finding Lemuria. Ant thinks Proteus is crazy. He tries to escape to save his family.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mystery Lane
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 The Riddle Maker A mysterious hacker named Ingenius takes the Law into his own hands and sets out to attack the elite pet population of London by remotely controlling connected electronic gadgets.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E6 The Emily Ghost Institute for Manners and Magical Etiquette Oscar and Hedgehog go to magical etiquette class.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 The Walk-a-thon The children face the difficult task of finding the right partner to be their walking buddy for the walk-a-thon. Tamara is determined to find the best companion who will assist her in doing the most laps.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 How Do You Solve A Problem Like Medusa Mavis accidentally on purpose invites Lydia's high school rival to the hotel.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E28 The Mutiny - Pt 2 Bonnie now controls the submarine. Jim is in exile, trying to find a new purpose as a water boy. But how can he adjust when he's been a captain all his life?

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 Jensen - Kirby And The Forgotten Land This episode is a mouthful of that hungry pink blob Kirby, as Jensen takes Gem for a ride through the Forgotten Land to search for Waddle-Dees!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E10 Transmission (The Kwami's Choice - Part 1) Sorry to see their holders so sad to have to give up on their feelings, Tikki and Plagg make a drastic choice that will change many a thing in Paris.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Cheer Captain Election Layla and Melody campaign against each other for cheer captain. Meanwhile, Ashton starts a side hustle to make some extra cash, and Heath debates returning to dance.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Paddington in Peru
ABCMESydney.au.description: Paddington is back in Peru, as he, and the Browns, visit his beloved Aunt Lucy. A thrilling adventure ensues when a mystery plunges them into an unexpected journey through the Amazon and beyond.

ABCMESydney.au.title: A Bite to Eat with Alice
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Pia Miranda Actress Pia Miranda gifts Alice with jarred artichokes - will their efforts in the kitchen be a culinary triumph?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Songs of Praise ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: Faith in Eryri Aled Jones is in Eryri, also known as Snowdonia, to discover a historic church brought back to life, and to celebrate the Welsh language and the great outdoors.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E4 Anna Lucy aspires to be friends with her posh new neighbours, Toby and Anna, but hasn't reckoned on Lee dragging her back down to earth.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Midsomer Murders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E3 Breaking The Chain An international cycling competition comes to Midsomer. When the race leader is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson are drawn into a world of blackmail and bloodshed.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 And Baby Makes Two Ross argues with Greene about how best to care for dying AIDS patient, Chia-Chia. Benton treats an injured woman who refuses to press charges against her abusive policeman husband. The staff celebrates Weaver's day off.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 I Do Like a Jazzy Cigarette on Occasion Maria Williams, Jason Hoyte, Julia Morris and our famous episode four winner tackle Guy Montgomery and his wordy challenges: Feelings, The Animal Kingdom and Spell the Audience Member's Name.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI

ksby.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Now Peterson has his own show, which shares its title with his nickname: "Machinery Pete." Each episode features Peterson traveling to a farm machinery auction, where he meets some of the people who attend the sales where items like tractors and skid steers are sold. He also provides his analysis of current and historical trends in the used equipment market and answers viewer questions about what their equipment is worth in the Ask Machinery Pete segment. (Auction) - 2013-11-05

wvue.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
wvue.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wvue.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
wvue.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wvue.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ
wvue.us.description: Universal Basic Guys centers on two brothers, Mark and Hank Hoagies, who lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program. Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

wvue.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
wvue.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07
