fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Unbreakable
fxm.us.description: David Dunn (Bruce Willis) is the sole survivor of a devastating train wreck. Elijah Price (Samuel L. Jackson) is a mysterious stranger who offers a bizarre explanation as to why David escaped without a single scratch -- an explanation which threatens to change David's family and his life forever. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama, Science fiction) - 2000

fxm.us.title: Signs
fxm.us.description: Everything that farmer Graham Hess (Mel Gibson) assumed about the world is changed when he discovers a message - an intricate pattern of circles and lines - carved into his crops. As he investigates the unfolding mystery, what he finds will forever alter the lives of his brother (Joaquin Phoenix) and children (Rory Culkin), (Abigail Breslin). A unique story that explores the mysterious real-life phenomena of crop signs and the effects they have on one man and his family. (Thriller, Science fiction, Drama, Mystery) - 2002

fxm.us.title: The Sixth Sense
fxm.us.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Horror) - 1999

fxm.us.title: The Happening
fxm.us.description: An apocalyptic threat to humanity arrives out of the clear blue sky with a series of violent, inexplicable deaths spreading across the country. The cause of the terrifying phenomenon remains unknown, prompting science teacher Elliot Moore (Mark Wahlberg), his wife Alma (Zooey Deschanel) and his colleague Julian (John Leguizamo) to try to elude the invisible killer in Pennsylvania's farmland. Soon it becomes clear that no one is safe. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2008

fxm.us.title: The Village
fxm.us.description: The population of a small, isolated countryside village believes that their alliance with the mysterious creatures that inhabit the surrounding forest is coming to an end. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2004

fxm.us.title: The Hustler
fxm.us.description: The story follows Fast Eddie Felsen (Paul Newman) and his adventures in the world of professional pool. Fast Eddie is a young hopeful on his way to challenging Minnesota Fats (Jackie Gleason) for his world title. When he starts getting feelings for a woman he gets into a dilemma. (Drama) - 1961

fxm.us.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular
fxm.us.description: A showgirl from the San Francisco cabaret is murdered, and the only witnesses are fellow showgirls Stormy Tornado (Betty Grable) and Curly Flagg (Sheree North). Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown. (Comedy) - 1955

fxm.us.title: The Lieutenant Wore Skirts
fxm.us.description: Successful scribe and decorated veteran Gregory Whitcomb (Tom Ewell) is ordered to reenlist in the U.S. military, so his spouse Katy (Sheree North), a former participant in the Women's Army Corps, resumes her old post to be closer to him. Unfortunately, Gregory's been sitting behind a desk since World War II ended, and he soon learns he's too out of shape to serve. Now, as Katy searches for a loophole that will free her from the Army, Gregory haplessly tries to take her place on the home front. (Comedy) - 1956

fxm.us.title: M*A*S*H
fxm.us.description: Based on the novel by Richard Hooker, M*A*S*H follows a group of Mobile Army Surgical Hospital officers at they perform surgery and pass the time just miles from the front lines of the Korean Conflict. Led by Captains Hawkeye Pierce (Donald Sutherland) and Trapper John McIntyre (Elliott Gould), they add to the chaos and hilarity of the situation. (Comedy, War) - 1970

fxm.us.title: 9 to 5
fxm.us.description: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant. (Comedy) - 1980

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon
365blk.us.description: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first. (Action, Thriller) - 1987

365blk.us.title: Passenger 57
365blk.us.description: John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers. (Action) - 1992

365blk.us.title: Krush Groove
365blk.us.description: Russell Walker has started a new hip-hop and rap label called Krush Groove, which features a stellar list of acts that includes Kurtis Blow and Run-D.M.C. However, Walker doesn't have sufficient money to keep up the label, especially after Run-D.M.C. scores a big single. As he struggles to fund the label, more and more rap groups, like the Beastie Boys and LL Cool J, emerge in the New York City hip-hop scene. The film is based on the beginning of Def Jam Records. (Musical, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 1985

365blk.us.title: Purple Rain
365blk.us.description: A victim of his own anger, the Kid (Prince) is a Minneapolis musician on the rise with his band, the Revolution, escaping a tumultuous home life through music. While trying to avoid making the same mistakes as his truculent father (Clarence Williams III), the Kid navigates the club scene and a rocky relationship with a captivating singer, Apollonia (Apollonia Kotero). But another musician, Morris (Morris Day), looks to steal the Kid's spotlight -- and his girl. (Musical, Drama, Romance, Music) - 1984

365blk.us.title: Graffiti Bridge
365blk.us.description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain." (Musical) - 1990

365blk.us.title: Under the Cherry Moon
365blk.us.description: News of a trust-fund beauty (Kristin Scott Thomas) inspires the pianist (Prince) at a hotel in Nice on the Riviera. (Musical, Romance) - 1986

365blk.us.title: Carmen: A Hip Hopera
365blk.us.description: An engaged Philadelphia policeman (Mekhi Phifer) falls in love with a beautiful woman (Beyoncé Knowles) while dealing with a corrupt superior (Mos Def). (Musical) - 2001

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A man sues his estranged wife for unreturned property; she says they separated after he had an affair and fell in love with his mistress. (Reality, Law) - 2018-04-24

365blk.us.title: Peeples
365blk.us.description: After a year of living with girlfriend Grace (Kerry Washington), Wade Walker (Craig Robinson) is eager to propose to her, but she's still reluctant to introduce him to her snobbish family. When Grace leaves for a gathering at her parents' swanky compound, he hatches a plan to crash the assemblage, charm her folks, and slip a ring on her finger. However, his scheme soon goes awry, and Wade realizes that his only chance of marrying her is a take-no-prisoners confrontation with her father. (Romantic comedy) - 2013

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Daddy's Little Girls
365blk.us.description: Monty (Idris Elba), a mechanic, struggles to make ends meet and raise his three young daughters alone. When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together. (Romance, Drama) - 2007

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Family Funeral
365blk.us.description: A joyous reunion in small-town Georgia turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe, Aunt Bam and other family members gather for an anniversary party that turns out to be a sham. Instead of fun and relaxation, Madea and the gang soon find themselves attending an elaborate funeral that doesn't quite go according to plan. (Comedy) - 2019

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Switch
5starmax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
5starmax.us.description: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

5starmax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
5starmax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Carrie
5starmax.us.description: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror) - 1976

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Science fiction) - 1972

5starmax.us.title: The Hobbit
5starmax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

5starmax.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Science fiction) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Science fiction) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
5starmax.us.description: Based on the play by Tennessee Williams, this renowned drama follows troubled former schoolteacher Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) as she leaves small-town Mississippi and moves in with her sister, Stella Kowalski (Kim Hunter), and her husband, Stanley (Marlon Brando), in New Orleans. Blanche's flirtatious Southern-belle presence causes problems for Stella and Stanley, who already have a volatile relationship, leading to even greater conflict in the Kowalski household. (Drama) - 1951

5starmax.us.title: The Man
5starmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Catfish
5starmax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Player
5starmax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

bbcearth.us.description: Lions: Pride in Peril A film following the Tokitok pride of lions in Tanzania's breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Fashion Rachel celebrates the quirkiness and individuality of London fashion in her kitchen, proving it's more about creativity than the price tag when it comes to getting your food looking and tasting good.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Crowd Pleasers Rachel makes some simple colorful canapés that are perfect for a party and creates a sophisticated jelly for grown-ups.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nostalgia London makes Rachel feel nostalgic about her childhood, so she visits an ice-cream lab in North London and makes a firm family favorite - Strudel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Fast Food Rachel explores London's fast food scene, and whips up berry tartlets with cream cheese frosting and cauliflower cheeseburgers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Lazy Days Rachel prepares her favourite food for the perfect lazy day, cycles along a canal, visits her friend Tom's urban garden, and whips up a shepherdless pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 East Meets West Rachel celebrates London's love with the East as she makes sticky chicken with Malaysian salad and soft steamed buns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Traditional Values Rachel celebrates Londoners' love of tradition as she puts her own twist on the traditional fry-up and makes a simple one-tray roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On The Move Rachel joins an unusual supper club on an old tube carriage and makes sausage and mash for taxi drivers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 DIY Rachel visits a basement Norwegian style salmon smokehouse and a shop where the shelves are stocked with preserves made on a hob at home.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 The Pleasure's All Mine Rachel goes for a decadent champagne afternoon tea in Mayfair and makes some finger-licking ribs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

cartoonnetwork.us.title: Teen Titans Go!
cartoonnetwork.us.description: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013-04-23

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Family Secret

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Family Affair

csi.us.title: CSI - Turn Of The Screws
csi.us.description: A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.

csi.us.title: CSI - No More Bets
csi.us.description: Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.

csi.us.title: CSI - Bloodlines
csi.us.description: A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.

csi.us.title: CSI - Built to Kill: Part 1
csi.us.description: While Grissom leads a group of college students on a tour of CSI, the dead speak while the CSIs investigate, each narrating their own case

csi.us.title: CSI - Built to Kill: Part 2
csi.us.description: The CSIs investigate first-hand the behind-the-scenes action of Cirque du Soleil in order to determine what may have contributed to a young dancer's untimely death.

csi.us.title: CSI - Toe Tags
csi.us.description: Grissom is fascinated when every detail of a miniature is identical to that of a real crime scene, and he goes about trying to solve the case using the clues provided.

csi.us.title: CSI - Fannysmackin'
csi.us.description: When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.

csi.us.title: CSI - Double-Cross
csi.us.description: When a dead woman is found hanging from a cross inside a church, the team follows the evidence to uncover a bizarre love triangle dating all the way back to the victim's high school days.

csi.us.title: CSI - Burn Out
csi.us.description: When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.

csi.us.title: CSI - Post Mortem
csi.us.description: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

csi.us.title: CSI - Happenstance
csi.us.description: When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E16 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the brand new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit. Tiff and Jason are at the track with the two cheapest hot hatches on sale - the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki goes behind the scenes of famous Italian car designers Pininfarina - the people who have shaped every single Ferrari of the last 50 years. Tiff is joined by British rally star Mark Higgins in a test of two new SUVs with supercar power figures.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 18 Tiff is joined by German motoring legend, Sabine Schmitz, for a head-to-head battle between our two favorite sports cars of the last year, the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand-new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell pit what could be the greatest drivers' car of the century - the Toyota GT86 - against its tough rival from Renault Sport. Jonny Smith is in Spain to put Jaguar's brand new F-Type through its paces.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jonny Smith reveals the secrets of 21st century car crash testing. He goes behind the scenes at a crash test performed by experts Euro NCAP, before conducting his own shocking crash test between a car and a van.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 4 Tiff Needell heads to LA to check out the latest car trend to take the USA restomodding; it's the art of sympathetically restoring classic cars to modern standards while retaining their original charm, Tiff's behind the wheel of LA's best examples.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell host a battle of the best cheap hot hatches on sale. The Ford Fiesta ST, Renault Sport Clio and Peugeot 208 GTI are all thrashed to the limit before Tiff and Jason reveal the champion.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 6 Tiff is joined by Sabine Schmitz to pit the latest Caterham 7 against its rivals from Morgan and Ariel.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S22 E07 Tiff checks out the new convertible Aston Martin Virage; Jonny looks out for bargain off-road four-wheel drives; Stuart Broad and Matt Prior race the Jaguar XFR.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E06 Tim Shaw tests whether manufacturers' claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E07 Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta; Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels; Jonny shows us three great cars we could all suddenly afford to buy if we were to all stop drinking.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E08 Jason and Tiff battle against each other in the purest form of motor-sport: karting; Dirk Benedict joins Jonny Smith in a luxury road test with a difference; Tom Ford tests the Renault Laguna.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E09 Jason meets Moto GP star James Toseland in a feature where "Fifth Gear" makes a sports star's dream come true.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tom Ford puts the Grande Punto Abarth through its hot hatch paces; Tim Shaw finds out if it's possible to save huge amounts of money by servicing a car yourself; Bruno Senna is a special guest presenter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

(Reality, Law) - 2023-03-21

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly
shadesofblack.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club
shadesofblack.us.description: After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Eve's Bayou
shadesofblack.us.description: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan). (Drama) - 1997

shadesofblack.us.title: Brooklyn's Finest
shadesofblack.us.description: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny. (Crime drama) - 2009

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: The Island
shadesofblack.us.description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise. (Drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023

shadesofblack.us.title: As Good as Dead
shadesofblack.us.description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind. (Action) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: Night Train
shadesofblack.us.description: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2009

shadesofblack.us.title: Reasonable Doubt
shadesofblack.us.description: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: American Violet
shadesofblack.us.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Cops and Robbers
shadesofblack.us.description: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimewest.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtimewest.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtimewest.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtimewest.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtimewest.us.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
showtimewest.us.description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour
showtimewest.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
showtimewest.us.description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtimewest.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

showtimewest.us.title: The November Man
showtimewest.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey).

showtimewest.us.title: Side Effects
showtimewest.us.description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

showtimewest.us.title: Colossal
showtimewest.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world.

showtimewest.us.title: End of Sentence
showtimewest.us.description: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

showtimewest.us.title: Parasite
showtimewest.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

rifftrax.us.title: Rifftrax Live: House On Haunted Hill
rifftrax.us.description: Yes, horror classic House on Haunted Hill provides a mesmerizing walk down “people actually used to find this SCARY?!” lane. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with live commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: Father Frost
rifftrax.us.description: Father Frost may just be one of the greatest love stories of our time! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: The Girl From Rio
rifftrax.us.description: The Girl From Rio is about the island nation of Femina, which is inhabited by superwomen. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: The Magic Sword
rifftrax.us.description: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 60's fantasy classic! Spells will be cast! Heroes will be born! Bones will be siezed!

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: Kill and Kill Again
rifftrax.us.description: It’s your standard South African martial arts extravaganza based around root vegetable gasoline. You’re gonna love it, and love it again, with Mike, Kevin and Bill! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie.

rifftrax.us.title: Rifftrax Shorts: Why Doesn't Cathy Eat Breakfast? - Why Doesn't Cathy Eat Breakfast?
rifftrax.us.description: From the stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000 comes the comedic genius known as Rifftrax!

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Glasses for Susan
rifftrax.us.description: Susan needs glasses. Not like, “Oh, it's hard for her to read a small font.” No, Susan appears to be legally blind. Somehow she has made it to eight without wandering in front of a truck. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

rifftrax.us.title: Live: Plan 9 From Outer Space
rifftrax.us.description: Join Mike Nelson, Kevin Murphy and Bill Corbett live and onstage at the historic Belcourt Theater in Nashville as they riff along hilariously to Ed Wood's classic B-movie blunder Plan 9 from Outer Space.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - University of Wisconsin vs. University of California San Diego
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E12 The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center is electric as the Wisconsin Badgers face off against the UCSD Tritons on Championship Sunday. The match features a high-speed Racing intensity as both teams fight to stay alive in the single-elimination bracket. Fans will see the refined Skills of Kina Chang and the tactical precision of Lisa Ritchie as they trade "laser beam" drives and calculated dinks at the kitchen line. With Freestyle shot-making on full display—from around-the-post (ATP) winners to highlight-reel volleys—this quarterfinal clash proves that the best collegiate pickleball in the nation was truly saved for Sunday.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Women's Pro Singles - Jardim vs. Kop
pickletv.us.description: S1 E12 Get ready for a great singles match as Simone Jardim takes on Kristen Kopp at the Usopp National Pickleball Center. This venue, home to the Usopp Pickleball Academy, is a hub for lessons and training, making it an amazing facility for all things pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Women's Sr. Pro Doubles - Courter/Carter vs. Dawson/Williams
pickletv.us.description: S1 E21 This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. A key dynamic of this match is that Courter and Carter had the advantage of playing under the shaded court conditions just before, while Dawson and Williams were coming from outside. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Mixed Split Pro Age - Oncins/Jardim vs. Miscik/Domoracki
pickletv.us.description: S1 E16 Get ready for an exciting Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match featuring the formidable team of Jaime Oncins and Simone Jardim against the new pairing of Ryan Miscik and Christie Domoracki. Oncins is a former professional tennis player from Brazil. His partner, Simone Jardim, is a professional pickleball player, a Pickleball Hall of Fame inductee, and was once ranked the number one female player in the world. They face a new team with Ryan Miscik, a pro pickleball player and coach based in Venice, Florida. His partner, Christie Domoracki, is a player located in Boca Grande, Florida. This match brings together a mix of experienced pros and up-and-coming talent for a high-stakes competition on Florida's Paradise Coast.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : Ohio State University vs. University of Florida
pickletv.us.description: S2023 E6 The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. Referee Kate Johnson sets the tone early, enforcing strict regulations on net contact and service line precision to ensure every point is earned through pure grit. Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Bengaluru vs. Delhi - Day 5 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E9 It's a "Terrific Tuesday" at the World Pickleball League (WPL) as Day 5 features a critical matchup between the Bengaluru Jawans and the Delhi Dilwale. The stakes are high: Delhi, currently number five on the points table, has a chance to move to number three if the results go their way, while Bengaluru looks to bounce back from a recent loss.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : US Open 2023 – Women’s Senior Pro Doubles Quarterfinal – Wilhelm & Shirley vs LeBlang & Tarn
pickletv.us.description: S1 E33 In this gripping quarterfinal from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, Helen Wilhelm and Anna Shirley face Suzanne LeBlang and Teresa Tarn in a thrilling three-game battle. Featuring powerful strokes, smart resets, and tactical momentum shifts, this senior pro women’s doubles match highlights both experience and finesse. Watch as the teams adapt and clash in a showcase of skill and strategy at the highest level.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championship 2026 : 2026 Pickleball US Open – Saturday Match 2 - Waters/Devilliers vs. Sewing/Diamond
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E7 Saturday Match 2 from the 2026 Franklin US Open Pickleball Championships features Anna Leigh Waters and Jay Devilliers taking on Sofia Sewing and Casey Diamond in an exciting mixed doubles showdown. Watch high-level pickleball action with fast-paced rallies, strategic shot-making, and elite competition from some of the tournament’s top players.

pickletv.us.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball : Arizona Pickleball League 2023 – Week 4 – Trefry & Mercado vs Lloyd & Montoya
pickletv.us.description: S1 E18 In Week 4 of Season 2, the Arizona Pickleball League brings another exciting Tuesday night match at The Orchard. This week, the Peoria Pythons take on the Surprise Stingers, with thrilling moments and intense competition. Featuring standout players like Ryan Trefry, Lauren Mercado, Michael Lloyd, and Nico Montoya, the teams face off in a high-energy battle. From dynamic mixed doubles to powerful gender doubles, every set and game keeps viewers at the edge of their seats. Will the Pythons maintain their momentum, or will the Stingers make a dramatic comeback? Don’t miss this action-packed match full of strategy, drama, and plenty of pickleball!

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : North Carolina vs. Virginia
pickletv.us.description: S2023 E8 The stage is set at the Collegiate National Championships for a high-stakes final showdown between the defending champions, the University of North Carolina Tar Heels, and the powerhouse University of Virginia Cavaliers. In an electric atmosphere fueled by a raucous Virginia crowd, the "third man" in the stands, both teams battle for the ultimate prize: the national championship trophy. Watch as top-tier athletes like former soccer player Caitlin Lewis and lefty specialist Lorelai lead their teams through a technical "reset clinic," showcasing elite defensive rallies that would impress the pros. With Sarah Carpenter adding her multi-sport prowess to the mix, this four-game match delivers high-velocity firefights, strategic timeouts, and momentum shifts that define the pinnacle of collegiate pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Purdue vs. Creighton
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E16 Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 Semifinal - Utah Tech vs. Florida Atlantic University
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E13 The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Pro Men's Doubles - Livornese/Deheart vs. Lane/Newell

This semi-final match features the dynamic duo of Richard Livornese Jr. and Ryler Deheart against the formidable team of Ben Newell and Brandon Lane. Witness incredible rallies, aggressive plays, and strategic dinks as these top players battle it out for a spot in Championship Saturday. Don't miss this high-energy competition from the epicenter of pickleball!

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Rosati/Campbell
pickletv.us.description: S1 E2 In this US Open 2025 Pro Women's Doubles match, the Waters duo (Anna Lee Waters and Lee Waters) take on Amanda Rosati and Kaitlyn Campbell. The commentators highlight the Waters' dominant performance, particularly Anna Lee's disguised shots and aggressive play, as they secure a swift victory. They also discuss the challenges of the progressive draw format in pickleball and preview Anna Lee Waters' upcoming mixed doubles match with Andre Agassi.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - Purdue Boilermakers vs. Liberty Flames

The Racing intensity of the match is underscored by "nasty rips" and rapid-fire exchanges that leave no room for error. In a Freestyle display of collegiate grit, both programs fight through momentum shifts and "money bag" pressures to prove they belong among the nation's elite.

retroplex.us.title: Ambush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Frontier Fugitives
retroplex.us.description: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Range Beyond the Blue
retroplex.us.description: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation. (Western) - 1947

Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: Twilight in the Sierras
retroplex.us.description: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez). (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: Stars Over Texas

It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene. (Western) - 1946

While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud

Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E07 Arkansas An aerial view of Arkansas, where settlers' westward journeys began and the scene of Bonnie and Clyde's most serious crime; a view of the land of raging rivers, vast wilderness and legends of the Wild West. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E17 North Carolina The Wright Brothers gave the state its slogan "First in Flight"; civil rights leaders in Greensboro; NASCAR. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E04 Super Stallion Helicopter Mike joins the U.S. Marines' Heavy Haulers helicopter squadron and gets inside their battle to keep a fleet of souped-up Sikorsky CH-53E Super Stallion choppers flying as they prepare for intense war games in the desert and mountains. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E04 Panama Canal Railway A ride on the Panama Canal Railway reveals the track repairs, engine overhauls and dangerous searches involved in keeping vital freight runs rolling. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E01 Heli-Logger A crew and its massive air crane helicopter haul millions of pounds of timber while battling the elements and handling emergency repairs. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E02 Heavy Cargo Express A ride through Eastern Europe aboard heavy-hauling trains shows the logistical and mechanical challenges of making a multimillion-dollar cargo delivery. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E03 Euro Hauler Following a million-dollar freight run across four European countries and meeting the drivers, engineers and maintenance teams who keep the train running. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E07 Scream Machines Mike works with repair and construction teams at Dreamworld, Australia's largest theme park, after a cyclone caused $4M in damage; they fix scream machines and finish a $50M expansion featuring the world's first triple switch rollercoaster. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E06 Toronto Tunnel Host Mike Davidson assists on a multi-million-dollar tunnel-boring project underground in Toronto. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E05 Abandoned Oil Wells Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation; they work to find and cap some of the estimated 2 million leaking, toxic abandoned oil and gas wells scattered throughout the U.S. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E02 Savannah: Mega Cranes & Mega Moves Mike helps fix the machines that keep one of the United States' biggest ports moving; he assists a team in moving a 3-million pound crane. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E05 Deep Sea Fish Farm Host Mike Davidson helps make high-stakes repairs for one of the world's largest open-ocean fish farm operations in Panama. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E06 Snowbird Ski Resort Mike Davidson embarks with the team to one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone ski mountains in the world: Snowbird; they battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E08 Extreme Heights: Rope Access Repairs Mike pushes himself to the limit to work with an elite team of high ropes techs on fixes hundreds of feet in the air; starting 45 stories up on the side of a skyscraper, then working and dangling on the edge. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E08 Philadelphia Transit In Philadelphia, Mike is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages; he is working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of America's largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E04 Water Bombers: Fixing Aerial Firefighters With wildfire season ahead, Mike works with an aerial firefighting company as they fix and convert aircraft into firefighting machines, including the transformation of a 1960's C130 plane from aged military aircraft into a stateofthe art waterbomber. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E02 Deep Space Telescope Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama Desert in Chile; at observatory ALMA he works alongside the expert team as they repair some of the world's biggest antennas. (Episode, Series, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E20 New Mexico An aerial view of New Mexico; exploring its landscapes and landmarks, while revealing its many legends and secrets. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E43 Wyoming An aerial exploration of Wyoming reveals the Cowboy State's controversial history while highlighting its breathtaking canyons and volcanic formations. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E63 Trailblazers An aerial tour over the places made famous by America's most influential men and women. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E39 Idaho A view of Idaho from the air reveals a state filled with agricultural fields, lands untouched by human hands, and riches in the form of gold, ski resorts and spuds. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E67 Northern California A flight over Northern California explores ancient forests, timeless coasts, golden cities and the region's pioneering spirit. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)
