that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Whole Lotta Love
that70sshow.us.description: Red fires Eric from his job at Pricemart after hearing about his engagement; Nina invites Fez to spend the night with her. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030219

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Battle of Evermore
that70sshow.us.description: Rivals (guest stars Fred Willard, Seth Green) try to best Red and Eric in a father-son, Paul Bunyan competition. Bob Goldthwait also guest stars. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030226

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Hey, Hey What Can I Do?
that70sshow.us.description: The gang goes to a job fair at a local motel; Eric is determined to find a job since Red refuses to pay for college; Kelso decides he wants to be a police officer. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030312

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Bring It on Home
that70sshow.us.description: The Formans discover Jackie has been sleeping at their place because she has nowhere else to go; Fez realizes Nina is reluctant to introduce him to her family. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030326

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - No Quarter
that70sshow.us.description: Eric must return Donna's engagement ring after he receives a collection notice. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030402

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Trampled Under Foot
that70sshow.us.description: Kitty invites a creepy teenager over to be part of Eric's circle of friends; the gang sees Fez's bedroom for the first time. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030409

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - You Shook Me
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde and Kelso ogle sexy nurses at a convention. Rozonda "Chilli" Thomas guest stars. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030416

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Nobody's Fault but Mine
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde tries to make amends after Jackie discovers he cheated on her; Red pressures Eric and Donna to set a wedding date. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030423

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Immigrant Song
that70sshow.us.description: The police catch Fez painting the water tower and threaten him with deportation; Eric and Donna continue to make plans to move to Madison, Wis. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030507

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Celebration Day
that70sshow.us.description: The gang gets ready to graduate with the class of 1978; Kelso and Hyde fight over Jackie; Eric and Donna say farewell to childhood; Fez comes up with a plan to stay in the country; Red fantasizes about life after the children are gone. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20030514

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Kids Are Alright
that70sshow.us.description: Eric has second thoughts about moving to Madison with Donna; Jackie is vexed when Hyde finds someone new (Estella Warren); Laurie returns home to her new husband after a wild honeymoon in Cancun. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031029

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Join Together
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie and Hyde turn to Kelso for relationship advice; Donna prepares to leave for Madison without Eric. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031105

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Magic Bus
that70sshow.us.description: Eric celebrates his 18th birthday by dropping Donna off at the bus station for her move to Madison; Red and Kitty get intimate for the first time since his heart attack. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031112

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Acid Queen
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso tries to prove he hooked up with the high-school valedictorian (Shannon Elizabeth) at a Molly Hatchet concert; Eric attempts to check out adult magazines at the local library. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031119

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - I'm Free
that70sshow.us.description: After Brooke reveals the big news, Kelso begins to get excited about the prospect of having a baby; the INS visits to determine if Laurie and Fez's marriage is legit. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031126

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - We're Not Gonna Take It
that70sshow.us.description: After Eric loses his job, he finds himself up for the same waiting job as Kelso; Donna and Jackie send newly single Bob a box of fudge to cheer him up. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20031203

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Christmas
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie invites the guys to her high-school dance; Kelso visits Brooke (Shannon Elizabeth) at the library; Kitty casts Red as Santa Claus, sparking a rivalry between him and Bob. (Episode, Series, Holiday, Sitcom) - 20031217

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - I'm a Boy
that70sshow.us.description: When Eric works the late shift at the restaurant, Kitty and Donna treat him like a king; Kelso takes Brooke (Shannon Elizabeth) on a double date with Hyde and Jackie; Fez spends a day with Red. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040107

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Young Man Blues
that70sshow.us.description: During his police-academy training, Kelso rides along for a domestic disturbance call from the Formans' house; Jackie tries being a Big Sister. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040114

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - A Legal Matter
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso convinces the guys to help him break into the police academy's office; Fez prepares for his INS test. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040204

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - I Can See for Miles
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso takes Brooke to the hospital on his bike after Eric and Donna inadvertently rolled his car off a cliff; Jackie decorates Hyde's room. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040211

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Sally Simpson
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso tries to set up Fez with a girl from the police academy; a stress specialist determines that Eric is the cause of Red's constant irritation. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040218

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Won't Get Fooled Again
that70sshow.us.description: Donna misses one of her birth control pills; Kelso and Fez wait until Suzy (Alyson Hannigan) is gone to confess that they miss each other. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040225

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Baby Don't You Do It
that70sshow.us.description: Brooke (Shannon Elizabeth) sees red when Kelso burns down the police academy; Pastor Dan (Billy Dee Williams) provides premarital counseling to Eric and Donna. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040303

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Who Are You?
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie's mom, Pamela (Brooke Shields), returns from her vacation, then joins Bob in the hot tub; Kelso enrolls in a new police academy. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040310

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - A Man With Money
that70sshow.us.description: Donna and Jackie send Fez to test Pamela's (Brooke Shields) love for Bob; Red has to wear a heart monitor that drives Kitty crazy. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040317

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Happy Jack
that70sshow.us.description: Donna and Eric decide to be celibate until they marry; Fez and Hyde realize how much Kelso has changed when they visit him at the academy. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040324

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Do You Think It's Alright?
that70sshow.us.description: Donna exacts revenge on Eric for not shopping with her by sending him shopping with Jackie; Hyde forbids Jackie to talk about marriage. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040331

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Substitute
that70sshow.us.description: New guy Mitch (Seth Green) tries to make out with Donna; Bob asks Pamela (Brooke Shields) to move in with him. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040421

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Squeeze Box
that70sshow.us.description: Mitch (guest star Seth Green) tells Donna a secret about Eric that makes him seem less than desirable; Red and Hyde see a side of Pamela (guest star Brooke Shields) they will never forget. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040428

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - 5:15
that70sshow.us.description: Mitch (Seth Green) invites Donna to go with him to his brother's wedding; Fez pretends to be rich to impress a woman; Red gets cable installed. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040505

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Sparks
that70sshow.us.description: Chaos results when Eric sneaks a peek at Donna's wedding dress before the big day; Red needs to find a truly meaningful wedding gift for the couple. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040512

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - My Wife
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's bachelorette party takes a surprising turn when Kelso's brother, Casey (Luke Wilson), turns out to be the emcee at a strip club. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040516

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Going Mobile
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso becomes afraid of fatherhood when he meets Brooke's (Shannon Elizabeth) mother, Carolyn (Morgan Fairchild); Eric has second thoughts about marrying Donna and leaves town to sort things out. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040519

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Seeker
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's mother returns to console her daughter; Kitty finds Hyde's birth certificate and makes a discovery about his father; Eric tries to explain his actions to Donna. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040519

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Time Is on My Side
that70sshow.us.description: Eric makes plans to sell Donna's engagement ring to fund taking a year off, but when he learns Donna threw it from the water tower the gang goes searching for it, with disastrous results. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040908

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Let's Spend the Night Together
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde gets a big surprise when he meets his real father; Eric and Donna attend a feminist rally; Kelso prepares for the arrival of his baby. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040915

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction
that70sshow.us.description: Eric tries his hand at vandalism; Red buys a local muffler shop; Kelso's daughter gives him a newfound respect for women. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040922

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Beast of Burden
that70sshow.us.description: After Red offers him a job, Hyde must choose between working with Red or his real father; Fez gets a job as a shampoo boy at the local beauty shop. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040929

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - It's Only Rock 'n' Roll
that70sshow.us.description: With an empty nest, Kitty decides on a course of self-improvement; Eric decides he wants to be an artist; Hyde learns the joys of business attire. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041006

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Rip This Joint
that70sshow.us.description: Eric encourages the gang to pull a prank on a crazy neighbor; Kitty takes a magazine quiz and learns that she has low self-esteem; Bob accuses Midge of flirting with W.B. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041103

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Mother's Little Helper
that70sshow.us.description: Fez becomes interested in a hot new client at the salon, but he faces some stiff competition from Kelso. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041110

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Angie
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde and his not-so-nice sister, Angie, fight for control of their father's company. Guest star Tim Reid. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041117

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - You Can't Always Get What You Want
that70sshow.us.description: Kitty is upset that the kids have other plans for Thanksgiving, Eric has tickets to a Styx concert and Hyde has his store's grand opening. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041124

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Surprise, Surprise
that70sshow.us.description: Hyde's sister, Angie, succumbs to Kelso's charms and agrees to a second date, then wakes up in bed with him. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041201

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Winter
that70sshow.us.description: When Kelso discovers a box of donated toys at the precinct, he mistakenly brings it home for the guys to play with; Hyde refuses to accompany Jackie to the Christmas event. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20041215

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Don't Lie to Me
that70sshow.us.description: Jackie, in an effort to impress a popular girl with a perfect life, says that Fez is a foreign prince, and she is engaged to him. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20050105

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Can't You Hear Me Knocking
that70sshow.us.description: When Kelso calls the White House to warn them about a Russian death ray, the entire gang becomes paranoid that the Feds are spying on them. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20050112

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Street Fighting Man
that70sshow.us.description: Donna gets tickets to the Packers game, and Eric convinces her to give one to Red, but he regrets his decision after Red's behavior gets them thrown out of the game. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20050209

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - It's All Over Now
that70sshow.us.description: George Carlin's comedy bit "Seven Dirty Words" is the inspiration for a revenge plot when Donna is fired from the radio station for refusing to wear a bikini. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20050216

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - On With the Show
that70sshow.us.description: Eric inspires Jackie to take control of her life, after she freezes on camera during her own public access show. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20050223

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Down the Road Apiece

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E09 Until Next Time, Derrick It's Diem's birthday and the cast celebrates; when the choosing begins for the male duel, Wes steps into the fray, and chooses Derrick for one disputed duel.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E10 The Duel After a hard night of drinking, Robin decides to question everything about Aneesa's identity, including her race and sexual orientation; Aneesa strikes back and reveals that she's truly hurt by Robin's actions.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E11 The Duel Brad and Eric discuss strategy while Evan and Wes hope to get Eric to take CT out of the competition; the Stacking Stairs challenge almost takes a surprising turn, but some previous winners pull out another big win.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E12 Two for Two As CT and Diem continue their love fest, the final girls consider Jodi their strongest competitor; Svetlana and Aneesa bond together to try to stay to the finals.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E13 The Duel Tensions run high as the guys face their second to last Duel challenge, and the surprising alliance of Evan and Wes comes to the surface; an incredibly challenging mission, Sunken Treasure, disqualifies all but one of the teams.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E14 The Duel The competitors must collect flags as they circle a 40-foot truss in the Around the Block challenge, a player goes back on her word and two women head to The Duel to play I Can.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E15 The Duel The Paddle Me challenge puts the final six's swimming skills to the test when they're told only the male and female winners will be safe from The Duel and automatically proceed to the finals.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E16 The Duel: The Big Payoff The final four compete in a challenge called The Rio Deal and the man and woman who come out on top walk away with $150,000 each.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S13 E17 The Duel Ain't Over 'Til the Reunion Miss USA 2003 Susie Castillo sits down with cast members from The Duel to discuss big moments from the season, including fights, hookups and never-before-seen footage.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S15 E01 Gauntlet 3: Hola, Mexico Thirty-two competitors arrive in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, in an attempt to win $400,000 in cash and prizes.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S15 E02 Gauntlet 3: A Tale of Two Gauntlets "Screw You" and "Roped In" challenges; Tyler confesses his feelings for Ryan; backstabbing accusations lead to a verbal brawl.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S15 E03 Gauntlet 3: Gone Baby Gone Brooke and Evelyn's romance jeopardizes their security; a birthday celebration turns scandalous; "Blind Man's Maze" challenge.

thechallenge.us.title: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S15 E04 Gauntlet 3: Frankly, My Dear A new player is able to offer the rookies some hope; deliberations go awry; the players take on the Man Overboard challenge.

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
tastemade.us.description: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Smoked Brisket Hero
tastemade.us.description: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Steakhouse Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Pulled Pork Party Hero
tastemade.us.description: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Bougie Badass Burgers
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle Dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese. (Cooking) - 2023-05-31

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - The Art of Open Fire Cooking
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert. (Cooking) - 2024-07-03

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Taco Like It's Hot
tastemade.us.description: Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pipian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who? (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
tastemade.us.description: For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills! (Cooking) - 2026-09-01

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
tastemade.us.description: Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Happy Halloween
tastemade.us.description: Boo! It's spooky season, and what better way to get into the spirit than with affordable, party-friendly Halloween dishes that scream trick or treat?! But be warned, these meals are scary good. (Cooking) - 2023-10-13

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Summer BBQ
tastemade.us.description: Summer is coming to a close, but there's still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that'll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill. (Cooking) - 2021-09-03

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meals Under $7
tastemade.us.description: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price! (Cooking) - 2023-11-03

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Rent Week
tastemade.us.description: It's that time, the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge looks pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and also teaches us how to better prepare for this. (Cooking) - 2020-02-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Eat Your Greens
tastemade.us.description: Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce. (Cooking) - 2023-04-13

tastemade.us.description: Boo! It's spooky season, and what better way to get into the spirit than with affordable, party-friendly Halloween dishes that scream trick or treat?! But be warned, these meals are scary good. (Cooking) - 2023-10-13

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Summer BBQ
tastemade.us.description: Summer is coming to a close, but there's still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that'll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill. (Cooking) - 2021-09-03

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meals Under $7
tastemade.us.description: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price! (Cooking) - 2023-11-03

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Rent Week
tastemade.us.description: It's that time, the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge looks pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and also teaches us how to better prepare for this. (Cooking) - 2020-02-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Eat Your Greens
tastemade.us.description: Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce. (Cooking) - 2023-04-13

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Let's Play Ball
tastemade.us.description: No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices. (Cooking) - 2021-10-15

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
tastemade.us.description: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens. (Cooking) - 2026-07-27

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
tastemade.us.description: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze. (Cooking) - 2026-08-17

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
tastemade.us.description: It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage. (Cooking) - 2026-08-03

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
tastemade.us.description: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice. (Cooking) - 2026-08-10

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
tastemade.us.description: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Smoked Brisket Hero
tastemade.us.description: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Steakhouse Hero

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Pulled Pork Party Hero

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Bougie Badass Burgers

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - The Art of Open Fire Cooking

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Taco Like It's Hot
tastemade.us.description: Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pipian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who? (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Grill'n After Dark - Go Burger or Go Home!
tastemade.us.description: Tonight is a trio of backyard burgers! We're making Oklahoma Smashed Onion Burgers, New York Steakhouse Burgers and Fries, and Bougie Castle-Inspired Sliders. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Grill'n After Dark - Midnight Sandwich Express
tastemade.us.description: It's sandwich night! We're making our favorite handheld late-night delights: Chicken Parm Hero, (Not a Philly) Cheesesteak, and Bodega Chopped Cheese. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Grill'n After Dark - Breakfast After Dark

tastemade.us.title: Grill'n After Dark - Late Night Mexican Food Truck

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi

Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Entertaining in Style We meet Mark and Laura who are in search of a luxury home. They need a house with the perfect kitchen and entertaining space. They will tour three homes in Los Gatos, California.

tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E21 Property Brothers - Tom & TJ Tom and TJ moved to Nashville to pursue a dream job, but they haven't yet put down roots and are cramped into a friend's studio apartment until they do.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E08 Property Brothers: Nathan & Jessica Tennis pros Jessica and Nathan have been living a cramped condo lifestyle for way too long. And now they're desperate to find a sprawling home in the country where they can put down roots and entertain family in style.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers

unxplainedzone.us.description: S03 E15 Aliens, Gods and Heroes Ancient alien theorists explore the extraterrestrial origins of mythological gods and ask whether stories of superhuman strength, supernatural powers and the ability to fly can be traced to factual events involving alien beings.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E07 Aliens and Bigfoot While ancient myths and legends speak of an ape-like giant stalking the earth, theorists speculate that Bigfoot creatures belong to an alien species that once visited Earth in the distant past.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S07 E08 Alien Breeders Mythological tales of intimate encounters with otherworldly beings point to possible alien intervention contributing to the genetic makeup of humans.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S09 E03 Aliens Among Us Exploring the theory that mankind's technological savvy comes from the work of extraterrestrials that watch Earth from outer space; inside the Inca legend, The Book of Enoch, that describes the Watchers descending to Earth to aid our advancement.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S09 E04 The Genius Factor Many brilliant minds believed they did not possess genius, but rather genius possessed them, like a spirit.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S08 E01 Alien Transports Theorists speculate that ancient stories about fiery chariots, flying carpets and fire-breathing dragons could be descriptions of misunderstood technology involving mysterious crafts.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E05 Sacred Discoveries From ancient religious texts buried in Egypt to cultural relics found at sea, or even a tower of skulls hiding under the earth, these lost artifacts change what is known about certain sacred beliefs.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E04 Military Secrets From clandestine nuclear weapons programs to a secret Cold War bunker hidden in the mountains, or even World War 2 technology at the bottom of the sea, we explore the unlikely people, and surprising places.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E06 Killer Finds From a deadly discovery hiding under one of America's most loved national parks, to a Nazi era weapon sunk off the coast of New Jersey, or even a bloodthirsty predator found in Canada--you never know where a killer find is hiding.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E02 Hidden Treasures Exploring some of the most valuable treasures found in the most unlikely of ways, like a priceless Ancient Roman mosaic hiding in a New York City apartment, or the most valuable piece of Americana tucked away in a $4 flea market find.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E07 Divine Discoveries Secrets of popes, rewritten laws and cities lost to the waves are divine discoveries that shake our beliefs and uncover mysteries.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E10 Deadliest Discoveries From an asteroid impact that nearly ended life on Earth to creatures once thought to be myths, and even a killer virus thawed from the ice, these finds reveal the dark side of discovery.

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87
classica.us.description: Der Pianist David Levy spielt die 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87, von Dmitri Schostakowitsch. Der Komponist ließ sich dazu von Bachs "Wohltemperiertem Klavier" inspirieren. Das Konzert fand 2023 im Budapest Music Center statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-04-05

classica.us.title: Bach - 5. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 5 in D-Dur, BWV 1050. Das Cembalo tritt zusammen mit Flöte und Geige in diesem Konzert als Solist auf. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-04-01

classica.us.title: Romeo und Julia
classica.us.description: Sergei Prokofjew gründete sein Ballett "Romeo und Julia" auf William Shakespeares gleichnamigem berühmten Stück und erzählt die Geschichte zweier junger Liebender aus den verfeindeten Familien Montague und Capulet. Der renommierte französische Choreograph Jean-Christophe Maillot schuf 1996 eine einzigartige Choreographie des Balletts, die weltweit aufgeführt wurde. (Special, Ballet, Music) - 2013-01-01

classica.us.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
classica.us.description: Das Veerhavenconcert ist eine jährliche Veranstaltung im Hafen von Rotterdam. Diese Aufnahme stammt vom 27. August 2016. Es spielt die Sinfonia Rotterdam unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen. Solisten sind dieses Mal Maria Warenberg (Mezzosopran) und Melle de Vries (Cello). Auf einer schwimmenden Bühne zeigen Spitzenmusiker dem Publikum auf den Booten im Hafen oder auf dem Kai, was sie können. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert)

classica.us.title: Im Atelier des Künstlers
classica.us.description: In dieser Serie spielt der Pianist Philippe Cassard in einer Meisterklasse Werke von Claude Debussy. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-07

classica.us.title: Bach - 2. Partita für Violin (BWV 1004)
classica.us.description: Die deutsche Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt dieses Mal zwei beeindruckende Solowerke für die Violine. So spielt sie von Johann Sebastian Bach die Partita Nummer 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 sowie auch die Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. (Special, Music, Event) - 2023-06-01

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
classica.us.description: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Barocke Chormusik von Bach, Schütz u.a
classica.us.description: Die amarcordplus-Formation präsentiert ein Programm, zugeschnitten auf die Stadt der Aufführung. Dieses Mal werden geistliche Madrigale von Johann Hermann Schein, Motetten aus Heinrich Schütz sowie zwei Motetten von Johann Sebastian Bach aufgeführt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-04-28

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Teatro Regio - Hinter den Kulissen
classica.us.description: Das Teatro Regio wurde 1740 mit der Aufführung eines Werkes von Francesco Feo eröffnet. Eine Blütezeit erlebte das Haus von 1895 bis 1898 unter der Leitung von Arturo Toscanini. 1896 fand dort die Uraufführung von Puccinis "La Bohème" statt. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2017-06-01

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 9. Sinfonie, Op. 125
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle präsentiert Beethovens neunte Symphonie. Die Solisten sind Iwona Sobotka, Anna Stephany, Robert Murray und Florian Boesch. Mit unvergleichlicher symphonischer Finesse komponierte Beethoven seine neunte Symphonie. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-09-06

classica.us.title: Klavierwerke von Rachmaninoff, Beethoven, Glazunov
classica.us.description: Der russische Pianist Nikolay Lugansky wird weltweit für seine Interpretationen von Sergei Rachmaninow gelobt. In diesem wunderbaren Rezital präsentiert der großartige Pianist eine Auswahl an Werken des russischen Romantik-Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-24

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-04

classica.us.title: Bach - Partiten für Violinsolo (BWV 1001-1006)

classica.us.title: Mahler - Kindertotenlieder
classica.us.description: Mahlers Kindertotenlieder ist ein zutiefst persönlicher Liederzyklus für Gesang und Orchester, inspiriert von Friedrich Rückerts Gedichten über den Verlust seiner Kinder. (Special) - 2026-03-07

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. classica.us.title: Fantasymphony - Ein Konzert voller Feuer und Magie
classica.us.description: Der Publikumshit Fantasymphony ist zurück. Diesmal gibt es epische Musik aus den größten Fantasy-Filmen, -Serien und -Spielen. itvmeridian.uk.title: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery
itvmeridian.uk.description: Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host as 'Win Win with Postcode Lottery' continues! itvmeridian.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Teleshopping
itvmeridian.uk.description: Shopping from home.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - South Donegal
itvmeridian.uk.description: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. (Cookery, Travel) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - Effortless One Pan
itvmeridian.uk.description: It's all about effortless and easy one pan wonders as Clodagh shares four all-time favourites. There's broccoli salmon noodles, a perfect 15-minute weeknight supper, and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta that always goes down a storm - both cooked in her lovely outdoor pergola kitchen. Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Unwind with ITV
itvmeridian.uk.description: A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvmeridian.uk.description: As the fifth series starts, we join the Fletchers adjusting to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Plans are in for the farmhouse rebuild following last year's fire, and as they await the green light, there's plenty to keep them busy. Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the 120 acres five years ago, and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: The Voice UK
itvmeridian.uk.description: Music superstars take on the role of coaches to find the UK's next great voice. The singer begins their audition with the coaches turned away. itvmeridian.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvmeridian.uk.description: James is back in the kitchen with award-winning actress Joanna Scanlon, who is currently appearing in ITV's The Party. Distinguished chefs Si King and Nick Nairn join James to cook and to answer Viewers' Questions.

itvmeridian.uk.title: ITV News
itvmeridian.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvmeridian.uk.description: Michael Brandon, Caroline Harker and Blue's Antony Costa and Duncan James join Alan. Elsewhere, Camilla Bassett-Smith takes viewers' gardening questions in Trowels and Tribulations, rum is the order of the day in today's Best of British, and there is the incredible story of Milo - a 15-year-old horse who is back competing after losing his sight. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: EFL Championship - Southampton v Portsmouth
itvmeridian.uk.description: Hugh Woozencroft presents live EFL action from the Championship as Southampton take on Portsmouth in the south-coast derby at St Mary's Stadium. Southampton have been in excellent form at home this season, winning all four of their league games at St Mary's, but local rivals Pompey will be confident of getting a result after heading into the international break unbeaten in their last three games. Last season neither side was able to claim local bragging rights. (Football)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itvmeridian.uk.description: Hosted by Emma Willis and Tom Allen, the celebrity cooking contest will see twelve stars mentored by twelve world-class chefs, as they compete in culinary cooking battles over the next ten weeks. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Celebrity Lingo
itvmeridian.uk.description: Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Good Morning Britain's Charlotte Hawkins and Sean Fletcher go head-to-head with Cold Feet legends Fay Ripley and John Thomson for charity. (Game show) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom (2018)
itvmeridian.uk.description: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet. - 2018
